title: プログラミング言語とコンパイラ
subtitle: Programming Languages and Compiler
teachers:
KUROSE Hiroshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn how a compiler works. This technology can also be used for analysis and processing of data formats distributed on the network. Students will also come to understand the control flow and data management methods of programming languages and gain a deeper understanding of programming languages by learning the compiler algorithms and their implementation technologies.
advice:
In this course, students learn practically how to develop compilers and interpreters through compact examples.

The following are the main items:
1) Programming language control structure and data management.
2) String search for text data, HTML, etc.
3) Compiler processing (lexical, syntax, expression, semantic analysis, code generation).
4) Memory management for program execution.
5) Execution environment (byte code, virtual machine, interpreter).
6) Compiler-related tools.

requiredKnowledge: As students evolve with programming languages, architectures, operating systems, software engineering, and usage, it is important for them to have a broad perspective. Since each process of your compiler may not work the first time, please check the operation yourself and gradually expand and understand the functions. Since this course requires knowledge of algorithms, programming, and operating systems, students should check themselves for weaknesses in those fields.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand principles of a compiler and explain how a compiler works.
Be able to extend the token type and syntax from the analysis sample codes.
Be able to explain the operation of functions necessary for program execution such as stack and heap, and data.
Be able to convert expressions to infix, prefix, postfix notation, or AST.

achievementLevels.ideal:
In addition to the standard achievement goal, students should:

Be able to understand the nature of a compiler algorithm and create a parser that suits their purpose.

Be able to read and extend the source code of compilers for existing programming languages.
achievementLevels.standard:
Be able to explain the compiler's processing flow and the characteristics of intermediate products.

Be able to extend the problem program based on the sample code to get normal output.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students learn practically how to develop compilers and interpreters through compact examples.

The following are the main items:
1) Programming language control structure and data management.
2) String search for text data, HTML, etc.
3) Compiler processing (lexical, syntax, expression, semantic analysis, code generation).
4) Memory management for program execution.
5) Execution environment (byte code, virtual machine, interpreter).
6) Compiler-related tools.

              As students evolve with programming languages, architectures, operating systems, software engineering, and usage, it is important for them to have a broad perspective. Since each process of your compiler may not work the first time, please check the operation yourself and gradually expand and understand the functions. Since this course requires knowledge of algorithms, programming, and operating systems, students should check themselves for weaknesses in those fields.
